title: KalamTime Instant Messenger
meta_description: Fast Instant messaging app with real-time translation. Make HD audio-video calls
full_description: KalamTime is an amazing instant messaging application for you. KalamTime helps facilitate multi-party video and voice calls, not just that, KalamTime makes it easier for you to send texts, share audio messages, your location, contacts, documents, pictures, videos, and much more!Safe and SecureSecurity is paramount to KalamTime, and when you choose KalamTime, you’re choosing an instant messenger that prioritizes your safety. KalamTime employs state-of-the-art encryption technology to ensure that only you and the person you’re in contact with can see your messages, listen to your calls, and nobody including KalamTime can infringe on this. Real-Time TranslationHave you ever needed instant translation while conversing with people that speak a different language from you? Thanks to KalamTime, you never have to worry about conversing with amazing people around the world. You can translate every text message to the language of your choice. KalamTime supports all of the most spoken languages of the world.Text and Audio ConversionWith the KalamTime, life is easier than it has ever been, you can instantly listen to all text messages. You can convert audio messages into text making it easier for you to share the outputs with as many people as you wish. You can also type out texts and automatically have it turned into an audio message. Sounds good?Edit Sent MessagesOn most instant messaging apps, you cannot edit sent messages but with KalamTime, you can! Without sending an unnecessary alert to the receiver. You can now edit already sent messages sent to friends, family, business partners, and everyone in between, there’s nothing like the KalamTime experience, and you’ll love it.Forward Messages like a BossWith the KalamTime forwarding feature, you get to retain the rights to your messages because our app will show the owner of every forwarded message, it’ll also show when each forwarded message was originally sent.Make New Friends, Maintain Current RelationshipsThere are few instant massaging platforms that help you make new connections and maintain existing ones as KalamTime does. We’ve gone above and beyond to ensure that there are no barriers when you need to find new friends and main relationships with your existing contacts.Zero Limits with KalamTimeEmbrace true freedom today by downloading the KalamTime. With our app, you can share files of unlimited size with your contacts. Do you have a lot to say? Record and send videos and audio messages of unlimited length. A New Group Call Experience - No Limit on the Number of Participants on CallsThe days of subpar group call experiences are behind you, thanks to the KalamTime. It helps you experience amazing group calls with no limit on the number of participants on calls. Complete Privacy ControlKalamTime puts the power back in your hands;  you have a complete privacy control, and you can hide your phone number, email, online status, profile picture, and even stop your profile from showing up in the search results.Multi-Device FunctionalityHow frustrating is it when you try to send instant messages on your laptop or tablet, but you cannot because your phone isn’t connected to the internet, or you’re not willing to go through the hassle of “pairing” multiple systems?KalamTime feels your pain and understands what it feels like to not have multi-device functionality. With KalamTime, you get a platform that’s synchronized but also works independently on all of your devices.Broaden your horizon with KalamTimeThe future of communication is here, and KalamTime has made things that were only possible in Sci-fi movies. KalamTime has around 90 features that enable you to make secure, meaningful and amazing connections with your friends and family members. What are you waiting for? Why don’t you welcome KalamTime into your life so that you can experience what it truly feels like to be secure and safe when connecting with those that matter.
